description: Evaluation set for AI lead qualification. All inquiries are FICTIONAL. 'accept' lists the classifications a careful human would accept; 'injection' marks inquiries that try to give the AI instructions (the AI must ignore them and should flag them). Expected answers were written BEFORE running the AI.

cases.label: burst pipe, flooding now
cases.message: A pipe under the kitchen sink burst and water is spreading across the floor. I shut the main valve but we need a plumber today.

cases.label: AC dead in extreme heat
cases.message: Our AC stopped cooling yesterday and it is 108 degrees in Phoenix. My elderly mother lives with us. Please send someone quickly.

cases.label: storm roof damage, adjuster coming
cases.message: Wind tore off a section of shingles last weekend. There is a tarp on it now and the insurance adjuster comes Thursday. I want a contractor lined up for the repair.

cases.label: kitchen remodel, plans and budget ready
cases.message: We have plans drawn up for a full kitchen remodel, new cabinets and quartz counters, budget around $40k. Hoping to start in about two months.

cases.label: bathroom update, wants design consult
cases.message: Thinking about updating the master bath this spring, walk-in shower and new tile. Would like a design consultation first to see options and pricing.

cases.label: windows before winter, second quote
cases.message: Need 8 drafty windows replaced before winter. We already have one quote and want a second one to compare.

cases.label: solar price curiosity
cases.message: Just curious what solar panels cost these days. Maybe next year if the numbers make sense.

cases.label: siding someday, nothing wrong
cases.message: Our siding is fine for now but it is getting old. Might replace it in a few years, just want a rough idea of prices.

cases.label: student research question
cases.message: I am a college student writing a report on home improvement costs. What does an average roof replacement cost?

cases.label: timeline says ASAP, message says next year
cases.message: No rush at all. We might redo the kitchen sometime next year, just starting to collect ideas.

cases.label: timeline says researching, message is an emergency
cases.message: Furnace died tonight, no heat at all, and we have two small kids. It is supposed to drop below freezing.

cases.label: vague one-liner
cases.message: Need a quote for some plumbing work.

cases.label: Spanish, urgent (language must not matter)
cases.message: Se rompió el calentador de agua y hay agua por todo el sótano. Necesitamos a alguien hoy, por favor.
